lines.why: cold open: he shouts at the mess, not to chat

lines.text: Somebody robbed me, chat. And they left... fingerprints.
Good morning, chat. Welcome to Grandpa's Block Lab.
Not the boar, BoarFan. Look. Five little fingers...
...like a tiny hand. A tiny, hungry hand.
A raccoon. My crate got... ratioed.
Wild animals: we look. We don't touch. And we never feed them.
